faq.question: How do I add a transaction?
faq.answerMobile: Tap the + button at the bottom of the Dashboard or Transactions page. It's always visible on both screens.
faq.answerDesktop: Click the Create Transaction button on the Dashboard or on the Transactions page. Fill in the amount, category, and date, then save.

faq.question: How do I create a budget?
faq.answer: Navigate to the Budgets page and click Add Budget. Choose a category, set a monthly limit, and FinSight will track your spending against it.

faq.question: Can I have multiple accounts?
faq.answer: Yes! Go to the Accounts page and click Add Account. You can create as many accounts as you need, each with its own currency.

faq.question: What does display currency mean?
faq.answer: Your display currency is the default currency pre-selected when you create a new account. Each account can still have its own individual currency.

faq.question: How do I export my data?
faq.answer: Data export is coming soon. In the meantime, you can view your transactions on the Transactions page and summaries on the Dashboard.
